notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.
